title: S31 — Segmentation probe: measure where current segmentation fails on the 13 hard misses
desc: Of the 13 hard misses on current main (100 - 87 = 13), how many fail at the SEGMENTATION stage vs the MATCHING stage? Method: for each hard miss, run the reader pipeline up to segmentation (before template matching), inspect whether the correct glyphs were extracted. If segmentation fails (misses a glyph, splits one glyph into two, merges two glyphs), that's a segmentation fix. If segmentation succeeds but matching fails, that's a recognition fix. Deliverable: per-miss diagnosis table (segment OK / segment FAIL) + the segmentation-fail family breakdown. This tells us whether to invest in better segmentation or better recognition. Owner: scott (best at diagnostic probes). Priority: 1. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
